Apery_zeta_3.name: Apery zeta(3)
Apery_zeta_3.description: The special zeta value zeta(3), a standard transcendental constant from number theory.
Apery_zeta_3.benchmark_purpose: Used to check whether the FSOT constant stack can reproduce a pure-math target that is not tied to any laboratory unit.

Soldner.name: Soldner constant
Soldner.description: The positive zero of the logarithmic integral, a classic constant from analytic number theory.
Soldner.benchmark_purpose: Shows whether Wave 7 can reach a named analytic constant outside the usual physics benchmark set.

Mills.name: Mills constant
Mills.description: A specialist constant associated with a prime-generating floor formula.
Mills.benchmark_purpose: Tests whether the FSOT basis can hit a more obscure prime-related benchmark rather than only famous constants.
Mills.citation: Caldwell and Cheng, J. Integer Sequences 8 (2005); Weisstein, MathWorld 'Mills' Constant' (2026)

Sierpinski_constant.name: Sierpinski constant
Sierpinski_constant.description: A named constant from number theory and asymptotic combinatorics.
Sierpinski_constant.benchmark_purpose: Extends the benchmark layer into specialist pure mathematics rather than only standard physics observables.
Sierpinski_constant.citation: Finch, Mathematical Constants (2003), Sierpinski constant entry
Sierpinski_constant.notes: Accepted literature value entered from standard mathematical-constants references.

Niven.name: Niven constant
Niven.description: A named number-theory constant used in the thesis as a compact analytic benchmark.
Niven.benchmark_purpose: Checks whether the FSOT constants remain coherent on a specialist mathematical target with no physical unit attached to it.
Niven.citation: Niven, Proc. Amer. Math. Soc. 22, 356-360 (1969); Weisstein, MathWorld 'Niven's Constant' (2026)

Artin.name: Artin constant
Artin.description: The Artin constant from primitive-root statistics in number theory.
Artin.benchmark_purpose: This is one of the two Wave 7 targets that explicitly reuses mathcal C, so it checks the resolved observer-coupling constant inside a pure-math context.
Artin.citation: Finch, Mathematical Constants (2003); Weisstein, MathWorld 'Artin's Constant' (2026)

Hafner_Sarnak.name: Hafner-Sarnak constant
Hafner_Sarnak.description: A specialist analytic number-theory constant used in the thesis benchmark list.
Hafner_Sarnak.benchmark_purpose: Adds another non-physical pure-math target so the wave is not only fitting familiar constants.
Hafner_Sarnak.citation: Hafner, Sarnak, and McCurley, A Tribute to Emil Grosswald (1993); Vardi, Computational Recreations in Mathematica (1991); Weisstein, MathWorld 'Hafner-Sarnak-McCurley Constant' (2026)
Hafner_Sarnak.notes: Resolved to the n = 1 Hafner-Sarnak-McCurley benchmark, D(1) = 6/pi^2, because it is the only member of the family consistent with the thesis formula and the stated 1% tolerance.

Porter.name: Porter constant
Porter.description: A named mathematical constant from number-theory style asymptotics.
Porter.benchmark_purpose: Widens the benchmark set beyond the most famous constants into more specialized analytic terrain.
Porter.citation: Knuth, The Art of Computer Programming Vol. 2, 3rd ed. (1998), p. 357; Weisstein, MathWorld 'Porter's Constant' (2026)

Thue_Morse.name: Thue-Morse constant
Thue_Morse.description: A constant associated with the Thue-Morse sequence, a standard object in combinatorics and dynamics.
Thue_Morse.benchmark_purpose: Checks whether the FSOT constants can encode a target tied to sequence structure rather than to direct measurement.
Thue_Morse.citation: Dekking, C. R. Acad. Sci. Paris 285, 157-160 (1977); Weisstein, MathWorld 'Thue-Morse Constant' (2026)

MRB.name: MRB constant
MRB.description: A specialist number-theory benchmark constant included in the thesis Wave 7 list.
MRB.benchmark_purpose: This is the second Wave 7 target that directly depends on mathcal C, so it helps test the resolved observer-coupling term in a mathematical setting.
MRB.citation: Burns, unpublished note (1999); Finch, Mathematical Constants (2003), p. 450; Weisstein, MathWorld 'MRB Constant' (2026); OEIS A037077 (2026)
MRB.notes: Resolved to the standard MRB constant of Marvin Ray Burns, defined by the convergent alternating series sum_{n>=1} (-1)^n (n^(1/n) - 1).

Gauss_Kuzmin.name: Gauss-Kuzmin constant
Gauss_Kuzmin.description: The Gauss-Kuzmin constant from continued-fraction statistics.
Gauss_Kuzmin.benchmark_purpose: Checks whether Wave 7 captures a probabilistic number-theory target tied to continued fractions.
Gauss_Kuzmin.citation: Wirsing, Acta Arith. 24, 507-528 (1974); Briggs (2003); Weisstein, MathWorld 'Gauss-Kuzmin-Wirsing Constant' (2026)

Universal_parabolic.name: Universal parabolic constant
Universal_parabolic.description: A geometry constant associated with parabolic arc-length normalization.
Universal_parabolic.benchmark_purpose: Moves Wave 7 from pure number theory into analytic geometry to test the same constant stack on shape-based targets.
Universal_parabolic.citation: Finch, Mathematical Constants (2003), p. 479; Weisstein, MathWorld 'Universal Parabolic Constant' (2026)

Lieb_square_ice.name: Lieb square-ice constant
Lieb_square_ice.description: The entropy-style constant from the square-ice model.
Lieb_square_ice.benchmark_purpose: Bridges analytic mathematics and lattice statistical mechanics inside the same wave.

Komornik_Loreti.name: Komornik-Loreti constant
Komornik_Loreti.description: A constant from beta expansions and symbolic dynamics.
Komornik_Loreti.benchmark_purpose: Checks a non-physical analytic target tied to unique expansions and dynamical structure.
Komornik_Loreti.citation: Komornik and Loreti, Amer. Math. Monthly 105, 636-639 (1998); Weisstein, MathWorld 'Komornik-Loreti Constant' (2026)

Bloch_Landau.name: Bloch-Landau constant
Bloch_Landau.description: A complex-analysis benchmark constant related to analytic function bounds.
Bloch_Landau.benchmark_purpose: Pushes the wave into function-theory territory rather than only algebraic or physical benchmarks.
Bloch_Landau.citation: Rademacher, Amer. J. Math. 65, 387-390 (1943); Finch, Mathematical Constants (2003), pp. 456-459; Weisstein, MathWorld 'Landau Constant' (2026)
Bloch_Landau.notes: Using the standard tabulated Bloch-Landau benchmark as the Landau constant value commonly cited in references; mathematically this is the classical upper bound conjectured to be exact.

Golden_angle_deg.name: Golden angle
Golden_angle_deg.description: The standard golden-angle separation used in spiral phyllotaxis and packing geometry.
Golden_angle_deg.benchmark_purpose: Provides a geometrically intuitive target that readers can recognize without specialist background.
Golden_angle_deg.citation: Livio, The Golden Ratio (2002), p. 112; Weisstein, MathWorld 'Golden Angle' (2026)

Ising3D_eta.name: Ising 3D eta
Ising3D_eta.description: The anomalous-dimension critical exponent eta for the three-dimensional Ising universality class.
Ising3D_eta.benchmark_purpose: Tests whether FSOT can reproduce a standard condensed-matter critical exponent rather than a simple fixed constant.
Ising3D_eta.citation: Pelissetto and Vicari, Phys. Rep. 368, 549-727 (2002); later conformal-bootstrap consensus

Ising3D_alpha.name: Ising 3D alpha
Ising3D_alpha.description: The specific-heat exponent alpha for the three-dimensional Ising universality class.
Ising3D_alpha.benchmark_purpose: Checks the wave on a delicate near-zero critical exponent from statistical mechanics.
Ising3D_alpha.citation: Pelissetto and Vicari, Phys. Rep. 368, 549-727 (2002); later conformal-bootstrap consensus

Ising3D_delta.name: Ising 3D delta
Ising3D_delta.description: The field-response exponent delta for the three-dimensional Ising universality class.
Ising3D_delta.benchmark_purpose: Completes the Ising 3D subgroup so Wave 7 tests more than one critical exponent in the same system.
Ising3D_delta.citation: Pelissetto and Vicari, Phys. Rep. 368, 549-727 (2002); later conformal-bootstrap consensus

XY_nu.name: XY nu
XY_nu.description: The correlation-length exponent nu for the three-dimensional XY universality class.
XY_nu.benchmark_purpose: Extends the critical-phenomena tests beyond Ising behavior into a different symmetry class.
XY_nu.citation: Campostrini et al., Phys. Rev. B 63, 214503 (2001)

XY_eta.name: XY eta
XY_eta.description: The anomalous-dimension exponent eta for the three-dimensional XY universality class.
XY_eta.benchmark_purpose: Provides the second XY critical benchmark so the wave tests both scaling length and field behavior.
XY_eta.citation: Campostrini et al., Phys. Rev. B 63, 214503 (2001)

Heisenberg_nu.name: Heisenberg nu
Heisenberg_nu.description: The correlation-length exponent nu for the three-dimensional Heisenberg universality class.
Heisenberg_nu.benchmark_purpose: Checks a third major universality class so Wave 7 is not confined to one symmetry pattern.
Heisenberg_nu.citation: Campostrini et al., Phys. Rev. B 65, 144520 (2002)

Heisenberg_eta.name: Heisenberg eta
Heisenberg_eta.description: The anomalous-dimension exponent eta for the three-dimensional Heisenberg universality class.
Heisenberg_eta.benchmark_purpose: Pairs with Heisenberg nu to check the same class on two independent scaling observables.
Heisenberg_eta.citation: Campostrini et al., Phys. Rev. B 65, 144520 (2002)

Honeycomb_site.name: Honeycomb site threshold
Honeycomb_site.description: The critical site-occupation threshold for percolation on the honeycomb lattice.
Honeycomb_site.benchmark_purpose: Moves from critical exponents to connectivity thresholds in a standard lattice system.
Honeycomb_site.citation: Mertens and Moore, Phys. Rev. E 86, 061109 (2012)

SC_bond.name: Simple-cubic bond threshold
SC_bond.description: The bond-percolation threshold for the simple-cubic lattice.
SC_bond.benchmark_purpose: Checks whether the same constants can capture the onset of system-wide connectivity in 3D bond percolation.
SC_bond.citation: Lorenz and Ziff, J. Phys. A 31, 8147-8157 (1998)

SC_site.name: Simple-cubic site threshold
SC_site.description: The site-percolation threshold for the simple-cubic lattice.
SC_site.benchmark_purpose: Complements the bond threshold so the percolation subgroup covers two standard 3D connectivity transitions.
SC_site.citation: Lorenz and Ziff, J. Phys. A 31, 8147-8157 (1998)

m_u_over_m_d.name: m_u / m_d
m_u_over_m_d.benchmark_purpose: Starts the particle-mass subgroup with a light-quark ratio that is standard in hadron phenomenology.
m_u_over_m_d.citation: Aoki et al. (FLAG), Eur. Phys. J. C 82, 869 (2022)

m_s_over_m_d.name: m_s / m_d
m_s_over_m_d.benchmark_purpose: Extends the mass-ratio checks further into hadronic flavor structure.
m_s_over_m_d.citation: Aoki et al. (FLAG), Eur. Phys. J. C 82, 869 (2022)

m_tau_over_m_mu.name: m_tau / m_mu
m_tau_over_m_mu.benchmark_purpose: Closes Wave 7 with a clean charged-lepton ratio that readers can interpret without lattice or critical-phenomena background.
m_tau_over_m_mu.citation: PDG 2024 masses using m_tau = 1776.86 MeV and m_mu = 105.6583755 MeV
